mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO (PARTY_ID, PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID,PARTY_ABBR,PARTY_NAME,PARTY_ABBR_EN,PARTY_NAME_EN,REMARK,CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME) SELECT PARTY_ID, PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID,PARTY_ABBR,PARTY_NAME,PARTY_ABBR_EN,PARTY_NAME_EN,REMARK,CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME FROM INTERF_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TMP
mapper.select: MERGE INTO MST_COUNTER_PARTY A USING (SELECT party_id,party_customer_id,party_abbr,party_name,party_abbr_en,party_name_en,remark,create_user,create_time,create_dept,update_user,update_time FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO) B on (A.COUNTER_NAME=B.PARTY_NAME) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.counter_id=B.party_id,A.remark=B.remark,A.update_user=B.update_user,A.update_time=B.update_time WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (A.counter_id,A.counter_type,A.counter_name,A.remark,A.create_user,A.create_dept,A.create_time,A.update_user,A.update_time) VALUES (B.party_id, '02',B.party_name,B.remark,B.create_user,B.CREATE_DEPT,B.CREATE_TIME,B.UPDATE_USER,B.UPDATE_TIME )
